related_questions.question: Can the COVID vaccine be taken with other vaccines?
related_questions.snippet: You can combine most procedures, screenings, and vaccinations at the same appointment when you get your COVID-19 vaccination. Talk to your healthcare provider if you have questions. Children, teens, and adults may get a COVID-19 vaccine and other vaccines, including a flu vaccine, at the same time.

related_questions.question: What two vaccines cannot be given together?
related_questions.snippet: Note that there are two situations where vaccines cannot be given together: People who have anatomic asplenia (who do not have a spleen) or functional asplenia (whose spleen is not functioning properly) or have HIV should not get the meningococcal vaccine (MCV4) and pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV13) together.

related_questions.question: Is the COVID vaccine like other vaccines?
related_questions.snippet: While other vaccines trick the body's cells into creating parts of the virus that can trigger the immune system, the Novavax vaccine takes a different approach. It contains the spike protein of the coronavirus itself but formulated as a nanoparticle, which cannot cause disease.
